doc: Preregistration for M2 iterations (docs/BUILD_PLAN.md §0.1). One key per iteration under iterations. A key is written once, in its prereg commit, before any of its outcome_paths change; holon audit prereg checks the order and that the key is never edited afterwards. predictions count toward prediction accuracy; regressions are outcomes already recorded in the repo that must not change.

I16.title: Native C model, per-edge corpus, refinement records, metrics

predictions.claim: Native and .mjs agree on 100% of the refuter's candidates. Operationalized: for every M0 law, every candidate holon.refute.candidates yields (the whole candidate space, not stopped at the first hit), every claim term (both sides and every subterm, as holon.refute evaluates them) gives the same value on the native C model (an ELF binary, run with no node or bend reachable) and on the .mjs model, with evaluation errors compared as a class; results/M2/native.json records the same counts. A recorded fallback to .mjs is a miss of this prediction.

Per codec edge: 2,000 grammar samples, all boundary values, all witnesses. Operationalized for the 4 CODEC edges of the I11 M0 diagram (enc_sol, enc_go_v0, enc_go_v1, dec_go): exactly 2,000 seeded grammar samples; every sort-boundary value of whitepaper §8.7 (each Header field at 0, 1, max and max - 1, and the version at every version sentinel of the facts, within the edge's domain; for Bytes inputs the lengths 0, 1 and every length sentinel, and the first byte at 0, 1, 254, 255 and every version sentinel; rule tests_m2/_i16.py::required_boundary); every REFUTED M0 witness of the edge's input sort in its domain; and each edge's refinement record compares exactly that corpus.

0 disagreements on every faithful edge, v2 inputs included (enc_go_v1 writes byte 0 = 1 exactly as Go does), and decoder domains included. Operationalized: every edge is treated as faithful. Each per-edge refinement record reports 0 disagreements and equal model and real output digests. That covers the 4 CODEC edges, each compared with its own implementation, plus the decoder domains ok_go (Go validate()) and ok_sol (Solidity _loadBatchHeader) on a Bytes corpus built by the same rule.
